lines.text: Photo editor sliders, curves, and tool dials now run much faster with GPU histograms and live draft previews.
Starfish and Ultra 4× exports are faster and lighter on memory, with CPU co-processing and Mali L2 tiling.
16-bit TIFF exports are half the size with lossless compression, and wide-gamut P3 photos stay wide-gamut.
Fixed DR200/400 highlight headroom, grain aliasing, seamless 100% zoom tiles, and smoother HDR brackets.
